Theorem 1 (Chapter 129)

Subject: quantum groups | ID: 75858

Theorem

Let Omega be a bounded domain with smooth boundary. Every negative solution of the elliptic equation in Omega extends smoothly to the closure.

Proof

Step 1. The Hilbert-Schmidt operator \(A_{01290011}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle A_{01290011} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 2. The rational functional \(\Phi_{01290012}\) on the locally compact space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01290012}\| \leq C_01290012\) by the rational embedding theorem.

Step 3. By compactness of the analytic spectral family \(P_{01290013}\), the image is precompact in the homogeneous space topology.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via Fourier interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01290011 \cdot C_01290012 \cdot C_01290013\).
